blocks.text: Pituitary gland hypothalamus se ek danthal (stalk) ke zariye juda hai jise infundibulum kehte hain. Pituitary gland ke teen lobes (hisse) hain: anterior pituitary, posterior pituitary aur intermediate (median) pituitary.
Anterior pituitary bohat se hormones chhorta hai, aur in mein se kai hormones doosre endocrine glands ke kaam ko qaboo karte hain:

items: Growth hormone (GH, ya somatotropin): muscles, haddiyon (bilwasta, yani indirectly) aur doosre tissues ki growth barhata hai. Yeh metabolism ko theek chalane ke liye bhi zaroori hai.

Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH, ya corticotropin): adrenal cortex ko corticosteroids (cortisone aur aldosterone) chhorne par uksata hai, jo glucose aur namak ka homeostasis (andaruni tawazun) qaim rakhte hain.
Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH, ya thyrotropin): thyroid gland se thyroxine banwata hai, aur thyroxine aage oxidative respiration (oxygen wali respiration) ko tez karta hai.
Luteinizing hormone (LH): auraton mein ovaries se progesterone aur estrogen banwata hai aur ovulation (ovary se anda nikalna) shuru karta hai. Mardon mein testes se testosterone banwata hai.

Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH): auraton mein ovarian follicles ki nashonuma karta hai; mardon mein sperms ki nashonuma karta hai. FSH aur LH dono ko gonadotropins kehte hain (yani gonads par asar karne wale hormones).
Prolactin: mammary glands (chhati ke ghadood) se doodh banwata hai. Yeh mard aur aurat dono mein banta hai magar kaam sirf aurat mein karta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text:
Growth hormone se ilaj
GH un bachon ko diya jata hai jin ka qad GH ki kami ki wajah se chhota ho. Is se un ki growth ki raftar behtar hoti hai.
Lekin har baune (chhote qad wale) shakhs mein GH ki kami nahin hoti, is liye GH therapy har kisi ke liye munasib nahin.
Kuch log GH is khayal se lete hain ke is se muscle banenge ya budhapa der se aayega, magar doctor in maqasid ke liye GH ke istemal ki himayat nahin karte.

Posterior pituitary mein woh axons hote hain jo hypothalamus se shuru ho kar posterior pituitary tak aate hain. Yeh khud koi hormone nahin banata; sirf hypothalamus ke banaye hue hormones ko jama karta aur chhorta hai. Posterior pituitary yeh hormones chhorta hai:

items: Antidiuretic hormone (ADH ya vasopressin): gurdon se pani wapas rakhwata hai (water retention), yani peshab mein pani kam jata hai.
Oxytocin: mammary glands ke smooth muscles ko sukar kar doodh bahar nikalwata hai (milk ejection). Bachche ki paidaish ke waqt yeh uterus (rahim) ko bhi sukerta hai.

blocks.title: For Information: posterior pituitary ki banawat
blocks.text: Embryo (janeen) ki nashonuma ke dauran posterior pituitary neural tissue (asabi tissue) ke ek ubhaar se banta hai. Isi liye dimagh ka hypothalamus aur posterior pituitary axons ki ek raah (tract) se jure rehte hain.

blocks.alt: Hypothalamus, us ka danthal aur pituitary ke do lobes; anterior lobe tak khoon ki nalyan aur posterior lobe tak hypothalamus ke axons. Anterior pituitary se hare teer: TSH thyroid ko, ACTH adrenal cortex ko, FSH aur LH ovary aur testis ko, GH haddiyon aur skeletal muscles ko, prolactin mammary glands (chhati ke ghadood) ko. Posterior pituitary se laal teer: oxytocin mammary glands aur uterus (rahim) ko, ADH gurde ko.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hare teer anterior pituitary ke hormones hain aur laal teer posterior pituitary ke. Kitab ki tasveer mein GH aur prolactin ke teer posterior lobe ke neeche se nikalte dikhte hain, halanke yeh dono anterior pituitary ke hormones hain (kitab ka apna matn bhi yahi kehta hai). Is liye hamare khaake mein anterior ke tamam hormones (TSH, ACTH, FSH, LH, GH, prolactin) anterior lobe se nikalte hain. Posterior lobe sirf do hormones chhorta hai: oxytocin (rahim aur chhati ke ghadood) aur ADH (gurda), jo asal mein hypothalamus mein bante hain.

blocks.title: For Information: doodh pilane wali maa
blocks.text: Doodh pilane wali maaon mein bachche ki paidaish ke baad bhi oxytocin nikalta rehta hai. Isi liye un ka uterus doodh na pilane wali maaon ke muqable mein jaldi apne asal size par wapas aa jata hai.

Insanon mein intermediate pituitary anterior aur posterior pituitary ke darmiyan cells ki ek patli teh hai. Yeh melanocyte stimulating hormone (MSH) banata hai. MSH jild aur baalon ke melanocytes (rang banane wale cells) se melanin banwata aur chhurwata hai.

items: Barhte hue bachche mein growth hormone (GH) zyada nikle to gigantism hota hai: qad ausat se bohat zyada, aur haath, paon aur chehre ke naqoosh bare. Balighon mein GH zyada nikle to acromegaly hota hai: haddiyan lambi to nahin ho saktin magar moti hoti jati hain; haath, paon, khopri, naak aur jabra bare ho jate hain.

GH ki kami se dwarfism (baunapan) hota hai: nashonuma bohat aahista hoti hai aur qad chhota rehta hai. Lekin jism ke hisse aapas mein mutanasib (proportion mein) rehte hain aur dimagh ki nashonuma aur IQ par asar nahin hota.
TSH zyada ho to hyperthyroidism (thyroxine zyada) aur kam ho to hypothyroidism (thyroxine ki kami) hota hai.
ADH kam ho to diabetes insipidus hota hai: bohat zyada patla peshab aur baar baar pyaas. ADH zyada ho to gurdon ke masail ho sakte hain.
Oxytocin zyada ho to uterus ki deewar phat sakti hai, aur kam ho to normal labour (zachgi ka amal) ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Pituitary ko master gland kyun kehte hain, aur yeh poori kahani kyun nahin?
blocks.explanation: Anterior pituitary ke hormones (ACTH, TSH, LH, FSH) doosre endocrine glands (adrenal cortex, thyroid, ovaries, testes) ko chalate hain, is liye ise master gland kehte hain. Magar pituitary khud hypothalamus ke qaboo mein hai: hypothalamus releasing aur inhibiting hormones bhejta hai aur posterior pituitary ke hormones (oxytocin, ADH) bhi khud banata hai.

items: Teen lobes: anterior (GH, ACTH, TSH, LH, FSH, prolactin), posterior (ADH aur oxytocin sirf jama kar ke chhorta hai), intermediate (MSH).
GH zyada: bachpan mein gigantism, balighon mein acromegaly; GH kam: dwarfism.
TSH zyada/kam: hyperthyroidism/hypothyroidism; ADH kam: diabetes insipidus; oxytocin zyada: uterus ki deewar phatna, kam: labour mein rukawat.
